build_inverse_cooking_model: build an InverseCookingModel with ingredient encoder, recipe decoder, ingredient decoder, and image encoder components
run_get_model: run get_model to construct a full InverseCookingModel from args with ingredient and instruction vocab sizes
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the InverseCookingModel with image inputs, captions, and target ingredients to compute losses
run_sample_prediction: run sample on the InverseCookingModel to predict ingredients and recipe instructions from image inputs
